shared_elements: human figures in profile with elaborate headgear/costume
narrative relief scene with multiple participants
framing/border bands separating registers or enclosing the scene
processional grouping of figures facing a focal point
objects carried or held by figures
justification: Both are figural relief compositions with human figures in profile wearing distinctive headgear and holding objects, arranged along framed horizontal bands, which is a generic narrative-relief convention. They differ profoundly in specifics: A is a dense, curvilinear, symmetrical composition centred on a large tree flanked by seated and crouching figures with scrolling glyph-like ornament, while B is a set of orderly stacked registers of evenly spaced upright striding figures and led animals in a repetitive procession, with rigid vertical drapery and no central axial motif.
